entries.summary: Structured light has become an important tool across modern optics. By shaping properties such as amplitude, phase, polarization and spatial mode, researchers can create light fields with capabilities beyond those of conventional laser beams. These engineered light fields are…

entries.title: 'PAC-MAN' capsules that gobble up particles in turbulent water show promise for filtration and drug delivery
entries.summary: Scientists have created hollow capsules with single openings that can selectively filter particles thanks to the turbulence in surrounding waters—at times, ingesting particles like PAC-MAN eating up dots.
